test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Directions: Item in this section consists of a sentence with an underlined word followed by four words. Select the option that is opposite in meaning to the underlined word and mark your response in your Answer Sheet accordingly. 

I __object__ the false claims made against me.
solution: The correct answer is "assent."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ __ • The word "object" means to not like or to be against somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को नापसंद करना, उसके विरुद्घ होना) • Example: *Many people **object**__ to the new tax.* • The antonym of "object" is "assent." • The word "assent" means express approval or agreement. (अधिकारिक स्‍वीकृति देना) __ • Example: *Nobody would **assent**__ to the terms he proposed.* • Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Ease: **to become or make something less painful or serious. (राहत महसूस करना या पहुँचाना) • **Restore: **to put somebody/something back into his/her/its former condition or position. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को उसकी पूर्व दशा या स्थिति में लाना) • **Ascertain: **to find out or learn with certainty. (निश्चितता के साथ पता लगाना या सीखना) 13f:Ta44, The correct answer is **"First and foremost."**
